name: melodia_echo_topo
purpose: Topological DAG of Echo gates across agent lanes. Each gate is a node with explicit predecessor edges. The scheduler computes in-degree and dispatches eligible nodes to the model lane whose task class matches. Chapter 1 (First Dream) gates are the root layer; Chapter 2 (ecosystem expansion) layers fan out from their completion.

ch1_gameplay.label: Chapter 1 — First Dream vertical slice
ch1_gameplay.description: The core gameplay loop: sanctuary dialogue -> departure -> dream traversal -> one JRPG encounter -> typed result -> narrative consequence -> save. This is the linear Echo chain that existed as echo_pipeline.json. Chapter 2 layers depend on these gates' promote node.

runtime.label: Runtime — real input
runtime.contract: Q/W/O/P through BP_BattleUI::OnKeyDown, damage delta recorded, assertion JSON next to frames.

save_load.label: Save/load round-trip
save_load.contract: Canonical BP_JRPGSaveGame slot survives a full process restart.

repeat_consume.label: Repeat-consume idempotency
repeat_consume.contract: Flag + reward restore without duplication; melodia:stat idempotent per IntentId.

package_launch.label: Package launch outside editor
package_launch.contract: Development-packaged build launches outside the editor and the First Dream route is walkable.

promote.label: Promote Chapter 1
promote.contract: All four completion gates pass. git add for exact paths only, baseline fingerprints updated, AGENTS.md next-work tick advanced.

ch2_environment.label: Chapter 2 — Environment art pipeline
ch2_environment.description: Blender generative design -> T3D injection -> UE material compile -> portfolio render capture. Independent of gameplay execution once Ch1 promote passes, but converges at the project-level promote gate.

env_asset_author.label: Environment asset authored
env_asset_author.contract: Blender GN produces a candidate asset with documented provenance.

env_asset_inject.label: Environment asset injected + compiled
env_asset_inject.contract: T3D inject succeeds, material compiles 0 errors, shader instructions <= 150.

env_render_capture.label: Environment render captured
env_render_capture.contract: Beauty + wireframe + material grid renders saved with assertion metadata.

env_promote.label: Promote environment asset
env_promote.contract: Asset committed via git add <exact path>, LFS pointer verified, render archived.

ch2_website.label: Chapter 2 — Portfolio website
ch2_website.description: my-site-clean / wix / Vite MPA. Gated on renders from the environment layer producing them, but the build/deploy pipeline gates are independent.

site_lint.label: Website lints clean
site_lint.contract: markdownlint + stylelint + eslint pass with 0 errors.

site_security.label: Security audit
site_security.contract: No exposed secrets, no vulnerable deps, link-check passes.

site_assets.label: Renders ingested
site_assets.contract: Hero renders from env_render_capture placed in asset paths, metadata JSON valid.

site_deploy.label: Website deployed
site_deploy.contract: Production build deployed to Wix/GitHub Pages, live URL verified.

ch2_audiovisual.label: Chapter 2 — Audiovisual system
ch2_audiovisual.description: TouchDesigner audiovisual pipeline via Envoy MCP bridge. Produces renders and composition data for the website and the in-game rhythm presentation layer.

td_network_build.label: TD network builds
td_network_build.contract: TouchDesigner network compiles, all TOPs/DATs connected.

td_osc_validate.label: OSC bridge validates
td_osc_validate.contract: Envoy bridge sends/recv OSC, Melodia pulse matches TD time.

td_render_capture.label: TD render captured
td_render_capture.contract: Audiovisual render saved with frame metadata, archived.

ch2_second_dream.label: Chapter 2 — Second Dream expansion
ch2_second_dream.description: The next narrative gameplay loop beyond Chapter 1's First Dream. Depends on all Chapter 1 completion gates being promoted.

dream2_author.label: Second Dream authored
dream2_author.contract: New level + narrative content authored, spec validated against allowlist.

dream2_runtime.label: Second Dream runtime
dream2_runtime.contract: PIE-walkable, 0 crashes, real input through the loop.

dream2_promote.label: Promote Second Dream
dream2_promote.contract: All Second Dream gates pass, committed via scoped git add.

project_promote.label: Project-level promote gate
project_promote.description: Converges all Chapter 2 layer promote gates. A project-level commit/release may only happen when every eligible layer's promote node is PASS.

scheduler_contract.topological: Nodes with in_degree 0 are eligible. Recording a pass decrements the in_degree of dependents.
scheduler_contract.parallel_lanes: Independent layers (website build, TD network) run simultaneously. Dependent layers (website assets <- environment renders) serialize on their edges.
scheduler_contract.promote_rule: A promote gate may only record pass when ALL its predecessors have a ledger row with status=pass in the current or earlier session.
scheduler_contract.predecessor_syntax: Gates in the same layer reference by bare id. Gates in other layers use dot notation: layer_id.gate_id.
